record.title: Reverse heat-smoothing
record.statement:
Fix $d\ge 1$ and $1< p < \infty$. Show that there exists $c_p>0$ such that for all $n\ge 1$,
	\begin{enumerate}
 \item and for all polynomials $f$ on $\{-1,1\}^n$ of degree at most $d$, we have 
 

$$
\|\Delta f\|_p\le dc_p\|f\|_p
$$

 and thus 
 

$$
\|P_t f\|_p\le e^{tdc_p}\|f\|_p, \qquad t\ge 0,
$$

 where $P_t=e^{-t\Delta}$ is the heat semigroup on $\{-1,1\}^n$;
 \item and for all polynomials $f$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$ of degree at most $d$, we have 
 

$$
\|N f\|_p\le dc_p\|f\|_p
$$

 and thus 
 

$$
\|P_t f\|_p\le e^{tdc_p}\|f\|_p, \qquad t\ge 0,
$$

 where $P_t=e^{-tN}$ is the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck semigroup on $(\mathbb{R}^n,\gamma_n)$.
	\end{enumerate}
